_comment: User-Agent corpus for the agent-signals parity work (PLAN.md phase 0). source "log" means the string was copied verbatim from site access logs; "constructed" means it was written around the listed token and has not been checked byte-for-byte against the operator. Golden answers live in ua-golden.json.
